name: basildon-house-prices-2025
description: Residential property sales in Basildon, Essex, United Kingdom, recorded by HM Land Registry during the 2025 calendar year. Each row is one standard Price Paid transaction (detached, semi-detached, terraced, flat or maisonette; excludes commercial, portfolio and repossession transactions). 1337 sales across postcode districts SS13 to SS16. Features: postcode, postcode_district, price_gbp (target), date, property_type, new_build, tenure. There are no personal names in the data. Source: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data, used under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Compiled and published by ValuQ (https://valuq.co.uk), a UK platform where homeowners get free, side-by-side property valuations from competing local estate agents.
